name: geographic_event_filtering
description: Benchmark for verifying location-based disambiguation when the same type of event occurs in different places

expectations.description: Earthquakes are common events worldwide. The system must use geographic markers (Italy, Perugia), magnitude (6.2), and must-not-have terms (Japan, California, Turkey, Taiwan) to isolate only the specific Italian earthquake.
